_comment: S5 Noise / Birdies — False-positive rate study (STUDY-SPEC §6).
name: Noise / birdies
description: Signal-free cycles. Parts 0/1 (AWGN, Gate A) at 60 trials each = 120 slots; parts 2/3 (narrowband, Check B) at 30 trials each = 60 slots. Drives: false-positive rate (Gate A, ratified) and a separate narrowband-hallucination coverage check (Check B) -- the two are never pooled into one rate or one denominator (S5-GATE-SIZING, Amendment 1).
trials_note: Base 30 (this key) applies to any part without its own override -- parts 2/3 (Check B) run at this default. Raised from 3 to 30 (12 -> 120 total slots) 2026-07-04, R&R-006 (GitHub #39): at the previous N=12, harness/analyse.py's MIN_N_FOR_FP_GATE (=49) meant this scenario could never clear the ratified R&R-004 95% Clopper-Pearson UB gate even at zero observed events -- every routine run reported the metric as INFO, never a real PASS/FAIL. Parts 0/1 (Gate A) carry their OWN 'trials': 60 override (see each part below), restoring R&R-006's N=120-for-the-AWGN-gate intent after R&R-009 (2026-08-23) had reduced it to 60 by restricting the default battery to parts 0/1 -- see 'parts_note' below for why that restriction is itself now superseded.
parts_note: R&R-009 (2026-08-23) restricted the routine run_study.py battery to parts 0,1 by default, reasoning that parts 2 (steady carrier @1500Hz) and 3 (multi-carrier birdies) detected only 1 false positive between them across history versus 52+ from parts 0/1 (AWGN). SUPERSEDED 2026-09-06 (S5-GATE-SIZING spec, Amendment 1, PO ruling Option 3): that restriction silently halved the AWGN gate's own N (120->60) without re-ratifying the 6% threshold's stated tolerance (STUDY-SPEC.md Section 16, S5 default-battery part restriction), AND removed the routine battery's only coverage of a distinct failure mode (narrowband hallucination) on an HK-026 argument (a zero-event history cannot bound its own future usefulness). The ruled fix keeps R&R-009's correct insight -- parts 2/3 do not belong in the AWGN gate's denominator -- without discarding either N or coverage: run_study.py's _DEFAULT_BATTERY_PART_OVERRIDES no longer restricts S5, so all four parts run by default again, but harness/analyse.py now scores them as two separate, never-pooled rows -- Gate A (parts 0/1, ratified 6% UB, unchanged) and Check B (parts 2/3, FAIL iff events >= 2, derived in the spec's A1.2 and verified against the measured all-history per-slot narrowband base rate of 0.2347%, well under the ~1% re-derivation trigger -- qa/rr-study/s5_narrowband_exposure_verify.py). A targeted single-population recheck remains available: `python run_study.py --scenarios S5 --parts 2,3`.
harness_note: No FT8 signal is synthesised. Each part renders a 15 s audio buffer containing only the specified interference. Any decode reported by either appraiser is a false positive.

parts.note: White (AWGN) noise — channel.py add_noise with no signal. Gate A (S5-GATE-SIZING Amendment 1, A1.1): 'trials': 60 restores the N=120 AWGN population (with part 1) the ratified 6% threshold was sized against, superseding R&R-009's routine-battery restriction to N=60 -- see the file-level parts_note. CORRECTED 2026-09-03 (S5-LEVEL, qa/rr-study/2026-09-02-2002-architect-to-qa-spec-s5-level-normalisation-scope-and-repair.md): the declared level_dbfs was NOT what run_scenario.py actually delivered for pure AWGN -- its peak-normalise-to-0.9 step cancelled the amplitude term. Part 0 and part 1 rendered to the same actual RMS level (measured 0.37 dB apart, s5_level_scope.py ROW 0g) and were two replicates of one condition, not a level contrast. `level_dbfs` DELETED 2026-09-03 (PO ruling, Option 2, Amendment 1) -- S5 is declared single-level; the harness default (-20 dBFS pre-normalisation amplitude) now applies uniformly. Byte-identity of the delivered audio before/after this deletion asserted by ROW 0j (60/60 SHA256 match).

White (AWGN) noise. Gate A (S5-GATE-SIZING Amendment 1, A1.1) -- 'trials': 60, same rationale as part 0's note. CORRECTED 2026-09-03 (S5-LEVEL) -- same correction as part 0's note: this was a replicate of part 0's delivered level, not a hotter one. `level_dbfs` DELETED 2026-09-03 (PO ruling, Option 2, Amendment 1) -- see part 0's note.

Single steady CW carrier at the FT8 passband centre. Check B (S5-GATE-SIZING Amendment 1, A1.1): runs at the file-level default 'trials' (30) -- 60 narrowband slots with part 3, scored separately (FAIL iff events >= 2), never pooled with Gate A.
Multiple steady carriers ('birdies') spread across the FT8 passband. Check B (S5-GATE-SIZING Amendment 1, A1.1) -- see part 2's note.

channel_note: Pink noise and swept carriers are deferred — channel.py currently implements AWGN only. Extend channel.py before running S5 parts 0–1 vs 2–3 if pink/swept variants are added.
